title: Sejmik storey S-3: 47 desks, public gallery with proven sightlines; drawings moving to v1.1
stages: Site ✔ (zoning, heritage, survey, geotech, trees, neighbours)
Design research ✔ (trends, visuals, boards, façades, costs)
Concept v1.1 ✔ + Sejmik storey S-3 ✔ → merge into v1.2 with stair-A fix and cost check (workflow ►)
Production ►: drawings → v1.1 (workflow ►); plans re-run after S-2; photomatch tests ✔; extra showcase renders (workflow ►)
Boards ►: Stage II 8/8 skeletons with true-scale drawings (vis pending); Stage I 2/2; tables F.15/F.14.B ✔ (draft)
Audit ►: completeness 25/44; structural & functional audit ►; jury later
notes: Sejmik storey redesigned ('S-3') and verified by scripts: 47 councillor desks (43 + 4 wheelchair places, one per row) on 4 rows with 5 % side ramps; public gallery 31 + 3 wheelchair places with ≥ 77 mm sightline clearance to all presidium seats and the speaker; councillors' upper hall and the public gallery on separate mezzanines; two escape routes from hall, gallery and mezzanine.
Price of S-3: mezzanine 298 m² (≈ +118 m² vs the allowance) → ≈ +0.4–0.5 M PLN, which would eat most of the 0.82 M cost margin → the merge workflow must restore ≥ 1.0 M margin with documented levers.

Structural/functional issue carried into the merge: stair A flight is 5.15 m long where ≈ 5.9 m is needed for the 3.75 / 4.80 / 8.90 m storey heights — the merge must solve it geometrically for cores A, B and C.

Drawings are being updated to v1.1 (shown: east and south elevations with the lowered segment attic and glass balustrade, BIPV south wall of the segment with climbers at ground level, BIPV canopy over the garden terrace, tone-on-tone crown lamellas in a Fibonacci rhythm).
Still running: structural & functional audit, extra showcase renders, 3D (photomatch, reflections, Citizens' Hall interior).
